arguments.name: False removal of genuine background pixels
arguments.description: Predicted excluded pixels intersecting independently annotated valid background, divided by reference background pixels; average frames then canonical families. Fixed UI region excluded identically. Denominator is reference-defined, never selected by prediction.
arguments.noise_note: No noise sigma or powered MDE measured at registration; no numeric noise floor is assumed.
